data.title: Fire destroys restaurant, spa in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - A fire destroyed a three-storey building housing a resort restaurant and a massage and onsen spa in Karon district on Monday morning.

data.title: Deep South police station attacked, school closed
data.description: YALA - Gunmen fired shots at Lam Mai police station in Muang district of this southern border province on Monday morning, causing the closure of a nearby school while students were still arriving for classes.

data.title: Rescued elephant calf recovering but still has diarrhoea
data.description: KANCHANABURI - The starving elephant calf rescued near a fast-flowing stream in Sai Yok district is recovering well from her injuries and is reacting more to her surroundings, but still suffers from diarrhoea and her condition is being closely monitored by veterinarians.

data.title: Questions swirl over BJT unity
data.description: Although Bhumjaithai (BJT) leaders insist the party remains united, a series of recent developments has fuelled speculation over whether Thailand's dominant coalition partner is facing more than routine political tensions.

data.title: Centre to tackle ID and civil registration fraud
data.description: The government has launched a centre to coordinate action against fraud involving civil registration records and nationality documents in a bid to curb identity-related crimes.

data.title: Ministry looks into Mor Prom data discrepancies
data.description: An investigation into data verification and system errors within the Mor Prom mobile app will be mounted after more than 10,000 users lodged complaints regarding inaccurate medical records, the Ministry of Public Health says.

data.title: Thais urged to stay alert  for war risk
data.description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has urged Thai nationals in the Middle East to remain vigilant as regional tensions continue to escalate and the risk of further military attacks increases.

data.title: Co-payment scheme a B86.4bn hit
data.description: The Thais Help Thais Plus 60/40 co-payment scheme generated more than 86.4 billion baht in its first two months, the government said on Sunday.

data.title: Bonds sell out in '21 seconds'
data.description: Government Savings Plus bonds sold out just 21 seconds after subscriptions opened on Friday, reflecting strong demand for secure investments amid global economic uncertainty, the government said on Sunday.

data.title: Co-pay scheme a hit, but voters unswayed
data.description: Most participants in the Thais Help Thais Plus scheme found it beneficial in reducing living costs and boosting incomes, but many remained undecided about their support for the government, according to the latest survey by Nida Poll.

data.title: Exat drafts payout criteria for bridge in Koh Chang
data.description: TRAT: The Expressway Authority of Thailand (Exat) has outlined compensation criteria for landowners affected by the proposed Koh Chang bridge as residents raised concerns that payments may not be sufficient to help them relocate, despite broad support for the project.

data.title: Twenty provinces warned of flash floods
data.description: The Office of the National Water Resources (ONWR) has warned 20 provinces to prepare for possible flash floods, forest runoff, landslides and river overflows from Aug 2-4 as heavy rain is forecast in several regions.

data.title: Lao bank seeks police inquiry
data.description: Officials from Laos, including Lao Development Bank, have asked the Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) to investigate false allegations on social media linking the bank to money laundering.

data.title: Police under fire over missing case updates
data.description: Police in Chon Buri have apologised to the families of three Thai murder victims for failing to provide regular updates on the investigation, while insisting officers continued working on the case and remain committed to bringing those responsible to justice.

data.title: Dugong's death 'unclear'
data.description: Phuket: Marine scientists were unable to determine the exact cause of death of a juvenile male dugong found washed ashore in Phang Nga's Takua Thung district on Friday, as the carcass was in an advanced state of decomposition.

data.title: Anutin begins key visit to Indonesia
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul will begin an official visit to Indonesia on Monday, the first by a Thai PM to the country in 15 years, the government said.

data.title: NSB expands probe into Japan meth smuggling
data.description: The Narcotics Suppression Bureau (NSB) is expanding its investigation into a suspected transnational drug trafficking network after Japanese prosecutors decided not to pursue charges against a Thai woman arrested over methamphetamine hidden in coffee sachets she carried to Japan.

data.title: Govt reviews power deals
data.description: The government is reviewing long-term power purchase agreements (PPAs) with private producers as part of efforts to lower electricity prices, Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt said on Sunday.

data.title: Two police killed, 3 wounded in Narathiwat plantation firefight
data.description: NARATHIWAT - A manhunt was launched for an armed suspect after two Tak Bai police investigators were killed and three others wounded during a drug search in Tak Bai district on Sunday.

data.title: Suspect who exposed serial-murders gang now in witness protection
data.description: A murder suspect who told police there may be additional victims of the gang that killed two Russian siblings and a Thai family of three has been placed under witness protection, according to an informed source.

data.title: Woman courier cleared of drug smuggling in Japan returns home
data.description: A Thai woman courier suspected of smuggling drugs into Japan has returned to Thailand after convincing Japanese prosecutors she was unaware that crystal methamphetamine was hidden in coffee sachets in a package she carried for a client.

data.title: Police raid illegal Myanmar pub in Bangkok
data.description: Eleven Myanmar nationals, one a young teenager, were caught with ketamine at an illegal pub in Wang Thonglang district, Bangkok, raided by police early Sunday morning. The Thai proprietor was also arrested.

data.title: Thai choral festival to feature 21 choirs
data.description: The annual Thailand International Choral Festival begins on Monday and concludes on Friday at the Thailand Cultural Centre in Bangkok, with performances from 21 Thai and international choirs under this year's theme of "Sabai Sabai".
